scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Hey, you're carrying
way too much stuff. Why don't you stash it away in Kafra Storage? We can talk after you do that, right?
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
嘿，你帶的東西太多了，先存進卡普拉倉庫吧。
存好我們再聊，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
My name is Jaax.
Without ego, I can
say that I am perhaps the
^663300greatest inventor of our time^000000.
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
我叫賈克斯。
毫不自誇地說，我或許是^663300這個時代最偉大的發明家^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
This time, I've
created something
truly extraordinary. I call them... ^663300Magic Quivers^000000 !! This will be remembered in history as an
arrow revolution!
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
這次我創造了真正了不起的東西，叫作...^663300魔法箭筒^000000！！
這將是一場載入史冊的箭矢革命！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I've studied magic and quivers for years, working night and day until I finally figured how to condense arrows with magic! With magic quivers, you'll be carrying more arrows, but with less weight!
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
我研究魔法和箭筒多年，日夜鑽研，終於掌握了用魔法壓縮箭矢的方法！
使用魔法箭筒，就能帶更多箭矢，負重卻更低！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Would you like to try using one of my arrow quivers? I have no doubt that someone like you can appreciate my genius!
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
你想試試使用我的箭筒嗎？我毫不懷疑，像你這樣的人一定能欣賞我的天才！

太好了！帶著箭矢嗎？
只要^FF3131{2} Zeny^000000，我就能給你一個裝有{0}支{1}的箭筒。

給您！
請記住，^FF0000當您的負重達到最大負重限制的90%時，將無法使用箭筒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
So...
Just keep track
of how much you're
carrying from time
to time and you should
be alright.
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
所以...時不時留意一下負重，就沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I can't just give these away after working years
to develop this revolutionary technology!
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
抱歉，你的Zeny不夠。
我花了多年才研發出這項革命性技術，可不能白送！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You changed your mind?
When the glory of owning
a quiver is so close?
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
改主意了？
擁有箭筒的榮耀都近在眼前了啊！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You don't even
have {0} Zeny?
I'm so sorry. I had no
idea that you were so...
^333333Destitute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
您連{0} Zeny都沒有嗎？
真抱歉。我沒想到您會這麼...
^333333一貧如洗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
What...?
Do you not see that this invention can forever change the way Arrows are carried?! The future is now!
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
什麼...？
您難道沒看到這項發明將永遠改變箭矢的攜帶方式嗎？！未來已來！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You can carry a maximum of {0} Arrows within this quiver. It was made using my secret method,
so the total weight of the Arrows and Quiver is less than carrying the Arrows alone.
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
這個箭筒最多裝{0}支箭矢。
它用我的獨門方法制作，箭筒加上箭矢的總重量，比單獨攜帶箭矢還輕。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
It's a miracle of science! One that you can experience for yourself if you bring me at least {0} Arrows and {1} Zeny for each Quiver.
scripts.translation:
[發明家 賈克斯]
這就是科學的奇蹟！
每個箭筒需要至少{0}支箭矢和{1} Zeny，帶來就能親自體驗。
